Power is a acclaimed Starz crime drama that premiered in June 2014 and concluded its 6-season, 63-episode run on February 9, 2020. The series follows James "Ghost" St. Patrick, a nightclub owner leading a double life as a drug kingpin. The franchise includes spin-offs Book II: Ghost, Book III: Raising Kanan, and Book IV: Force. Key Details About Power (TV Series) Premise: James "Ghost" St. Patrick seeks to leave the drug world to pursue legitimate business, dealing with family, betrayal, and high-stakes drama. Seasons: 6 seasons (2014–2020). Episodes: 63 episodes. Finale: The show concluded on February 9, 2020, following a sixth and final season. Spin-offs: The Power universe has expanded to include several spin-offs: Power Book II: Ghost Power Book III: Raising Kanan Power Book IV: Force The original series and its expansions have been recognized as some of Starz's highest-rated content.
